description: What a Go + pnpm repository needs on top of the Renovate preset its runner applies.

packageRules.description: Keep the Go toolchain current: the go line in go.mod and tools/go.mod, and the golang image, move together. Without rangeStrategy bump Renovate leaves the go directive alone.
One Node version everywhere: .node-version and the node image.
TypeScript 7 (the Go port) is not supported by typescript-eslint or openapi-typescript yet; hold at 6.x until they are.
Postgres follows the cluster's CNPG image (major moves are migrations, not bumps).
